verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and this axis applies. The evidence covers only a REST API, webhooks, and mobile SDKs, with no mention of an MCP server. The llms.txt probe returned a 404, and the only AI-adjacent signal is markdown versions of the docs pages, which is not an MCP server.
